## CareDx to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences


November 20, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/505754850/files/doc_news/CareDx-to-Participate-in-Upcoming-Investor-Conferences-70d79021f-2026.pdf)


BRISBANE, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


CareDx, Inc. (Nasdaq: CDNA) — a leading precision medicine diagnostics company in transplant, specialty oncology, and cell therapy, today announced the company will participate in the following investor conferences:


- Evercore 9th Annual Healthcare Conference at The Loews Coral Gables Hotel in Coral Gables, FL. Fireside chat on Tuesday, December 1, 2026, at 1:45pm ET.
- Piper Sandler 38th Annual Healthcare Conference at the Lotte New York Palace in New York, NY. Fireside chat on Wednesday, December 2, 2026, at 3:30pm ET.


Live and archived webcasts of the presentations will be available on the “Events and Presentations” section of the CareDx investor relations website at[investors.caredx.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.caredx.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54644777&newsitemid=20261120691128&lan=en-US&anchor=investors.caredx.com&index=1&md5=790945f5dd1f60d4a2d72da68db47891) .


**About CareDx**


CareDx is a leading precision medicine diagnostics company advancing care in transplant, specialty oncology, and cell therapy. Through non-invasive longitudinal molecular biomarker testing, digital health, and patient support solutions, CareDx is dedicated to improving patient outcomes. For more information, please visit[www.caredx.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.caredx.com&esheet=54644777&newsitemid=20261120691128&lan=en-US&anchor=www.caredx.com&index=2&md5=de836e3b0175c05bef48e4d8b5425217) .
